notes: U.S. net sales only: Regeneron records EYLEA HD and EYLEA sales in the United States and Bayer records sales outside. The detail table prints the same product with decimals under the footnote label 'EYLEA HD (a)' or '(b)' beside combined totals; the two agree to rounding (checked 2025Q2: 393 vs 393.2; 2026Q2: 596 vs 596.3). Q4 quotes tie to full-year figures; 2025 quarters sum to the printed FY 1,637.

searched each release for 'EYLEA HD': first row in the Q3 2023 release (EYLEA HD - U.S. 43); no EYLEA HD line in the Q2 2023 release (pre-approval)
one release per quarter used, the quarter's own release; the 2024 quarters use the EYLEA HD - U.S. summary row, which is printed separately in every 2024 release (no combined row in the summary)

FDA approval: Drugs@FDA BLA 761355 overview lists ORIG-1 approval 08/18/2023; the letter appletter/2023/761355Orig1s000ltr.pdf was fetched. Page 1 of the letter has no text layer, so the approval sentence is not quoted; the signature block and the page 2 reference to approved BLA 761355 are quoted
